inference: Full official domains and conservation of all ten HdrB and eight HdrC reference pattern sites may support remote role architecture despite low whole-reference identity or a shorter non-ligand tail. This does not assign cluster type/occupancy, terminal substrate or electron bifurcation.
local_coupling_scope: A unique complete local MvhADG-HdrABC architecture with independent NiFe support and no competing complete module can support a coupling hypothesis while HdrA donor discrimination remains unresolved. Both HdrA references must be comparable; an alternative-favored HdrA or HdrA-FlpD fusion blocks this new route. The original 5-point donor margin is retained for donor discrimination; it is not a universal gate for this local hypothesis.
